findings.evidence: "The people operations office publishes the reimbursement log each quarter" vs. later "The benefits team publishes the reimbursement log after every open enrollment period"
findings.fix: Decide which is correct and revise both instances to match. If both are true, clarify what log each team publishes.
findings.violation: The document contradicts who publishes the reimbursement log and when (quarterly vs. after enrollment).

findings.evidence: "A copy of each update goes to the shared benefits folder the same day" vs. "Staff can request a printed copy from the benefits team at any time"
findings.fix: Clarify the distribution method: either it's automatically shared, or staff must request it - not both.
findings.violation: It's unclear whether the log is automatically shared or must be requested.

findings.evidence: "Then, the review takes longer because the manager who normally handles it is traveling; the backup reviewer who covers for absences was not told that the request needs sign-off before the portal releases the confirmation email."
findings.fix: Remove this paragraph or replace it with a general statement about what happens when the primary reviewer is unavailable.
findings.location: How to Apply section, third paragraph
findings.violation: This describes a specific incident or operational failure, not a general policy rule.

findings.evidence: "The manager approves items pursuant to internal discretion, notwithstanding the standard review checklist."
findings.fix: Clarify whether the manager has discretion over the checklist or must follow it.
findings.violation: "Notwithstanding the standard review checklist" contradicts the existence of a standard process - it's unclear whether discretion overrides the checklist or works within it.

findings.evidence: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition and we may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.fix: Standardize to one perspective: either "Employees must keep equipment in good working condition and the benefits team may request a brief photo check" or keep the direct address consistent.
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, first sentence
findings.violation: Point of view shifts from second person ("you") to first person plural ("we").

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."
findings.fix: Either list all steps in sequence or replace this with a reference to the detailed How to Apply section.
findings.violation: The section only describes the beginning of the process but doesn't explain subsequent steps or whether this is the complete list.

findings.evidence: A second "Overview" section appears after "Terminology Notes," duplicating content from the first Program Overview section.
findings.fix: Delete the duplicate Overview section, or consolidate both sections into one.
findings.location: Document structure, after Terminology Notes section
findings.violation: The Overview section is out of order and duplicates earlier content.
